name: Ishbell
source:
Lady Ishbell is the current heir to house Eudes, responsible for escorting Mahrenian ambassadors.
She was born from an affair and wasn't promoted until later.
Growing up as a commoner, she has developed a generous spirit; hence, she seems to get along well with Nazir.
